newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chevalier Group seeks loan for HK housing project.
newsitem.headline: Chevalier Group seeks loan for HK housing project.

text.p: The Chevalier Group plans to finance a Hong Kong housing project via a loan facility, bankers said on Tuesday.
The Chevalier Group won a contract for the private sector participation scheme ("PSPS") in Tuen Mun.
The development will have a site area of 397,630 square feet and gross floor area of 1.926 million square feet, and consist of 3,020 residential units in 12 tower blocks.
The project is scheduled for completion in mid 1999.
Bankers said the loan will be raised through a special-purpose company, Good Process Ltd, and guaranteed by Chevalier International Holdings Ltd and Chevalier Development International Ltd.

The loan size is HK$1,692 million and it will be divided into two tranches. Tranche A HK$342 million will be a bridging loan with a maturity of three months, tranche B HK$1,350 million will be a term loan facility with a tenor of 28 months.

Bankers said the facility will be completed as a club deal and has been fully underwritten by the arrangers. The arranger group comprises BNP Hong Kong, Sakura Bank, Fuji Bank, Sanwa Bank, China Construction Bank, Sumitomo Bank and Tokai Bank.
